delivery_proof.definition: A carrier-confirmed delivered-at timestamp or equivalent.
delivery_proof.note: SIMULATED 0/40 uses the pre-live reading of the public Zoho schema. The live response included shipment_delivered_date, blank on three checked shipments; its source is unverified and this does not establish carrier proof. Carrier integration remains the long-term route to independent proof.

zoho_documented_evidence.definition: Order, invoice, package, shipment status, carrier, and tracking number are present.
